name: 76442 · Comanche, TX
findings: ZIP 76442 (Comanche) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76442 (Comanche) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76442 (Comanche) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
